title: System Builder evidence provenance extension
description: Additive provider-neutral evidence provenance metadata for ArtifactEnvelope extensions. This metadata is evidence and traceability only, never execution authority; ADR-0009 core producer and provenance.inputs remain authoritative for artifact producer/input semantics.

evidenceId.$comment: Stable provider-neutral URI identifying this evidence metadata across compatible serialization.

sourceId.$comment: Stable provider-neutral URI for a non-artifact source reference.

sourceType.$comment: Stable source-kind token. No provider taxonomy is required by the core contract.

authorRef.$comment: Optional stable provider-neutral author/actor reference; it is descriptive evidence, not authorization.

correlationRef.$comment: Optional stable provider-neutral URI used only to correlate this non-artifact origin with related evidence or domain records.

locationHint.$comment: Optional non-authoritative URI hint. It may aid adapters but never replaces sourceId, requires no provider/storage identity and is not execution authority.

classification.$comment: Optional descriptive classification and/or confidence. Either field may appear independently; neither grants execution authority, correctness or authorization, and no default is inferred when absent.

confidence.$comment: Optional bounded descriptive confidence value. No vendor scoring model or truth semantics are implied.

descriptorId.$comment: Stable transformation descriptor token; it describes what produced evidence without requiring implementation coupling.

provider.$comment: Optional logical provider identifier only; provider resource IDs, endpoints, credentials and storage locators are outside this contract.

lineage.$comment: Evidence-to-evidence lineage only. Artifact predecessor identity remains in ArtifactEnvelope provenance.inputs.

integrity.$comment: Optional portable integrity descriptor for this evidence provenance metadata. It is evidence only, does not replace logical identity, and never grants execution authority.

digest.$comment: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest. No provider, storage locator, credential or secret material is encoded here.
